core_obligations: (1) implies (2) implies (3) by restricting to more divisible degrees and powers of the invertible sheaves.
(3) implies (1): a beta_0 with the lcm property is unique if it exists, because the Veronese maps psi and psi prime on the lcm degree stay surjective; uniqueness lets the question be localized on T.
Over an affine base the result follows from the triple equivalence plus the quadruple-triple correspondence of the affine case.
proof_roadmap: Run the easy directions, force localization via uniqueness of beta_0, reduce to the affine base, and transfer through the triple lemma.
